headline: Littler edges Humphries 11-10 to win the Premier League with 111 average
standfirst: Luke Littler won a last-leg decider against Luke Humphries in the Premier League final at The O2, averaging 111.67.
body: Luke Littler won the 2026 Premier League title at The O2 in London, beating Luke Humphries 11-10 in a final that went to a deciding leg. Littler averaged 111.67 and Humphries 105.60, making it one of the highest-quality finals of the season.
Littler also needed a deciding leg to reach the final. He beat Gerwyn Price 10-9 in the first semi-final, even though Price averaged 100.42 to his 98.47.
Humphries had his own last-leg finish in the other semi-final, edging Jonny Clayton 10-9 with averages of 96.16 to 95.86.
Littler hit 20 of the night's 45 maximums. Humphries managed 11 and Clayton eight. Price's 137 checkout in the semi-final was the highest finish at The O2, one ahead of Humphries' 134 in the final.
The win added the Premier League trophy to Littler's 2026 haul. It also continued his rivalry with Humphries, the pair having met in several of the year's biggest finals.
